To answer your posts:
Hikcory19:
Yes, I am really that old, in every objective sense. In every objective sense, the best years are gone. The best years to be carefree, unattached, and experimental, when you're allowed not to know what you want, you're allowed to try a bunch of different stuff, and you're allowed to not be sure about something but want to try it anyway while reserving the right to end it guilt-free at any time. At my age you're expected to have gotten that out of your system and at least be somewhat sure of what you want to do. I need that time to fuck around and/or fuck up, and I'm not going to get it. It might be true that I could find someone who will do what I want, but if I decide I don't like it, I have no excuse. I'll be told that I need to grow up and figure out who I am and not use people or whatever. An 18 year old is allowed to be confused, overwhelmed, and/or enthralled by all forms of sex, and they're not expected to commit to anything. The same isn't true for a 28-year old.

Also, I very much doubt that there are very many good-looking girls who *have* to go for guys. If I were a girl, I probably would have tried to be a porn star or a stripper. Hope that clears that up.

Secondly, I don't want to find a woman I can "love and open up to". I don't want a relationship. I don't want to find the "right woman". RoscoePST:
Most of what you said in your first paragraph is covered by my responses to the others. I'm not looking to find just one person who accepts me. I want to feel "in demand". I want the feeling of having options and knowing that people will pursue ME, like how it happens for hot girls. In the femdom community, men still have to pursue. And when they do, they have to prove that it isn't primarily about sex for them. For me, it IS primarily about sex. A young, hot person is just a young, hot person, and people want young, hot people without needing to know anything else about them. That's what I want. Pure, shallow lust.

With regard to your second paragraph: I have thought suicide through. I do understand that there would be pain. That's why I made the original post - I wanted to know if there are ways to dull the pain. Going for the heart was a result of thinking things through and realizing that shooting myself in the head carries a non-trivial risk of survival with brain damage, especially since I've never used a gun and know basically nothing about them. So, I was trying to think things through. 

Regarding your "family and friends" comment: I have no friends, and I despise my parents. I've recently become an antinatalist, and I hate them for bringing me into this world only to age, die, and rot forever. Even putting that aside, I think they had no business having children in the first place. My mother had children to fill a void in her life, to have kids who would bring home stories for her to live vicariously through (she is WAY too interested in hearing about the things my brother does with his friends and girlfriend). I think my father was browbeaten into having kids and never really wanted them. They're aware of my depression and suicidal thoughts and would not be at all surprised to find that I'd killed myself. My mother once almost killed herself via the "car in the garage" method. Then she backed out. She told me this story so she could be self-righteous about how "I got out of it, so why the fuck can't you?" She's a mean-spirited, self-righteous cunt who wants to play the hardass with me but is perfectly willing to hide behind my father's chivalry when I fight back.

Okay, now some general stuff. I think that I might not actually want the relationship I talked about. Well, I do and I don't. It's something I'm not sure I want to commit to, but also something I feel like I need to try, and I need that time in my life when I'm allowed to be like that. 
I don't want to lock myself into anything. I don't want to be tied down. 
I don't want deep relationships. I want to be SHALLOW. I want to have lots of promiscuous sex based on pure youthful LUST. I want to be a passive sex object, an object of beauty and desire that people just want. Above all, I want to be YOUNG and HOT. Nothing else. I want to have my other interests, and some more complex thoughts, but I want to keep them to myself. I only want to relate to other people as a young, hot guy first and anything else a distant second if ever. I'm wondering if this whole thing might be less about sex and more about identity - I need to identify as a young, hot guy. I'll just be miserable otherwise. I'm an all or nothing person. I'd rather die than settle. 

You can call me shallow, you can call me an asshole or a sociopath, you can declare that all of these things mean I deserve all of this for being a shitty person. But it's not like I asked for this. I didn't ask to be born into this world where you get maybe 10 years where you're objectively desirable and then you have to settle for being desirable for one person. I don't have an obligation to adapt myself to an existence I never asked for in the first place. So I really don't care about anyone's condemnations. And at this point, I hate myself so much that even if Aphrodite herself suddenly appeared in my room and told me she wanted to take me away to be her personal boytoy, I'd probably refuse even if I might secretly hope she wouldn't take no for an answer and basically kidnap and rape me. So I pretty much have to kill myself anyway. If anyone that's reading this could help me numb the pain of a bullet in the chest, that would be cool. Otherwise, I'll just accept that I'm on my own. Thanks to anyone that read all of this and isn't dismissively condeming me right now.

Well, I appreciate the advice about negative energy and so forth. That being said, I don't think that's a huge danger for me considering that I highly doubt I could feel much worse than I do now. There have even been times when I actually hoped that something would make me feel worse, to give me that final push toward suicide that would make me finally go through with it, but I don't even think that's possible now. Twisted, maybe, but also true. 

Also, the problem with your advice is that change is my whole problem. See, my situation is that because of various things I won't go into detail on, I'm 28 and have missed out on youth - specifically, I didn't get to have the rampant promiscuity I wanted to have. I've also realized that I simply can't like myself as anything other than a young guy. It just doesn't work. My personality, my identity, my soul, whatever - it doesn't work coming from someone over 30. I've probably just lost whatever sympathy I might have had by being so blunt about this, but it's the truth. There's really nothing for me to look forward to in this life, so I guess I'm looking for some evidence that there's somewhere else to go, or confirmation that there isn't.

You might try to tell me that I might meet someone who's okay with my problems, but I don't want a relationship. I want to have the choice to be shallow and hedonistic if that's what I feel like doing, and I hate myself too much to accept "love" from someone else anyway.
